title: cyperus pumilus var. patens
intro: Cyperus pumilus var. patens, commonly known as Dwarf Cyperus, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, including its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Dwarf Cyperus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and ease respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf Cyperus include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, analgesia, and antiviral activity.
